agent.reasons: Mateo Brandt, who is the CEO, control person and a 26% owner, has a potential sanctions match that hasn't been cleared, so the case must be escalated under 4.2. The rest of the case passes: ownership adds up to 100%, Nimbus's owners hold only 7.8% and 18.2% indirectly, all individuals have verified IDs, the registry filing is under 12 months old, and everyone is in the US.
